title: AIM-Bench: Evaluating Decision-making Biases of Agentic LLM as Inventory Manager

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating an anchoring factor to quantify the degree to which the LLM agent relies on the mean demand instead of sufficiently adjusting toward the optimal decision in the Newsvendor problem.
Measuring the correlation between current order quantities and previous demand realizations to assess if the LLM agent overreacts and insufficiently adjusts to recent demand fluctuations.

Evaluating the risk preferences of LLM agents (Prospect theory) by presenting the Newsvendor problem using two distinct contextual frames: a positive frame emphasizing expected profit and a negative frame emphasizing cost/loss.

Quantifying the amplification of order variance across supply chain echelons by calculating the ratio of demand variability between downstream and upstream agents in a simulated Beer Game environment.
